checks.name: script split into chunks under 5000 chars on sentence ends
neighbouring text passed: first has only next, last only previous, middle both
nothing lost: chunks rejoin to the script
PCM join keeps the exact timeline (drift < 1 ms)
negative control: -c copy MP3 join drifts by > 10 ms per join

negative_control: negative control: -c copy MP3 join drifts by > 10 ms per join

program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    sent = 'هذه جملة عربية قصيرة للاختبار تتكرر لتكوين نص طويل. '
    text = sent * 330
    chunks = split_script(text)
    rate = 44100
    mp3s, durs = ([], [])
    for i, c in enumerate(chunks):
        n = int(rate * (2.0 + 0.37 * i))
        x = 0.3 * np.sin(2 * math.pi * (220 + 40 * i) * np.arange(n) / rate)
        w = wd / ('chunk_%d.wav' % i)
        fx.write_wav(w, x, rate)
        m = wd / ('chunk_%d.mp3' % i)
        fx.ffmpeg('-i', w, '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-b:a', '128k', m)
        mp3s.append(m)
        durs.append(n / rate)
    lst = wd / 'list.txt'
    lst.write_text(''.join(("file '%s'\n" % p for p in mp3s)))
    copy = wd / 'joined_copy.mp3'
    fx.ffmpeg('-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', lst, '-c', 'copy', copy)
    decs = []
    for m in mp3s:
        d = m.with_suffix('.dec.wav')
        fx.ffmpeg('-i', m, '-c:a', 'pcm_s16le', d)
        decs.append(d)
    pcm = wd / 'joined_pcm.wav'
    parts = []
    for d, n in zip(decs, durs):
        a, r_ = fx.read_wav(d)
        parts.append(a[:int(round(n * rate)), 0])
    fx.write_wav(pcm, np.concatenate(parts), rate)
    probe_d = lambda p: float(fx.probe(p)['format']['duration'])
    truth = sum(durs)
    drift_copy = probe_d(copy) - truth
    drift_pcm = probe_d(pcm) - truth
    rep = jw(wd / 'join_report.json', {'chunks': [{'chars': len(c['text']), 'has_prev': c['previous_text'] is not None, 'has_next': c['next_text'] is not None} for c in chunks], 'truth_s': truth, 'drift_copy_ms': drift_copy * 1000, 'drift_pcm_ms': drift_pcm * 1000})
    return ([check('script split into chunks under 5000 chars on sentence ends', len(chunks) >= 3 and all((len(c['text']) < 5000 and c['text'].endswith('.') for c in chunks)), [len(c['text']) for c in chunks], '< 5000 each'), check('neighbouring text passed: first has only next, last only previous, middle both', chunks[0]['previous_text'] is None and chunks[-1]['next_text'] is None and all((c['previous_text'] and c['next_text'] for c in chunks[1:-1])), len(chunks), 'prev/next'), check('nothing lost: chunks rejoin to the script', ''.join((c['text'] + ' ' for c in chunks)).split() == text.split(), len(text.split()), 'same words'), check('PCM join keeps the exact timeline (drift < 1 ms)', abs(drift_pcm) < 0.001, drift_pcm * 1000, '< 1 ms'), check('negative control: -c copy MP3 join drifts by > 10 ms per join', drift_copy > 0.01 * (len(chunks) - 1), drift_copy * 1000, '> 10 ms x joins')], [pcm, rep])

title: Unified audio engine (voice + words + BGM + SFX)

checks.name: five words timed from the narration's energy (within 30 ms)
SFX land on their cue words (onset within 5 ms of the word start)
the bed is ducked ~12 dB under the voice
one manifest holds words, cues and files; the mix length matches it
negative control: the untreated voice track has no SFX transient at the cue

negative_control: negative control: the untreated voice track has no SFX transient at the cue

program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    rate = 48000
    words = ['هذا', 'اختبار', 'لساعة', 'واحدة', 'للصوت']
    starts = [0.3, 0.95, 1.7, 2.3, 3.05]
    lens = [0.4, 0.55, 0.42, 0.5, 0.45]
    dur = 4.0
    n = int(dur * rate)
    t = np.arange(n) / rate
    voice = np.zeros(n)
    for s0, L in zip(starts, lens):
        m = (t >= s0) & (t < s0 + L)
        env = np.sin(np.pi * (t[m] - s0) / L)
        voice[m] = 0.5 * env * np.sin(2 * math.pi * 170 * t[m]) * (1 + 0.3 * np.sin(2 * math.pi * 900 * t[m]))
    vw = fx.write_wav(wd / 'voice.wav', voice, rate)
    v, _ = fx.read_wav(vw)
    v = v[:, 0]
    hop = int(0.01 * rate)
    e = np.array([np.sqrt((v[i:i + hop] ** 2).mean()) for i in range(0, len(v) - hop, hop)])
    act = e > 0.02
    edges = np.flatnonzero(np.diff(act.astype(int)))
    segs = [(round((a + 1) * 0.01, 2), round((b + 1) * 0.01, 2)) for a, b in zip(edges[::2], edges[1::2])]
    timing = [{'word': w, 'start': s, 'end': e_} for w, (s, e_) in zip(words, segs)]
    cues = [{'id': 'whoosh', 'at_word': 1}, {'id': 'hit', 'at_word': 4}]
    for c in cues:
        c['t'] = timing[c['at_word']]['start']
    bgm = 0.25 * np.sin(2 * math.pi * 110 * t) * 0.5 + 0.25 * np.sin(2 * math.pi * 165 * t) * 0.5
    duck = np.ones(n)
    for w in timing:
        duck[int(w['start'] * rate):int(w['end'] * rate)] = 10 ** (-12 / 20)
    k = int(0.05 * rate)
    duck = np.convolve(duck, np.ones(k) / k, mode='same')
    sfx = np.zeros(n)
    for c in cues:
        i0 = int(c['t'] * rate)
        L = int(0.12 * rate)
        sfx[i0:i0 + L] += 0.6 * np.exp(-np.arange(L) / (0.02 * rate)) * np.sin(2 * math.pi * 2000 * np.arange(L) / rate)
    mix = voice + bgm * duck + sfx
    peak = np.abs(mix).max()
    mix = mix / peak * 0.89
    mw = fx.write_wav(wd / 'mix.wav', mix, rate)
    meta = jw(wd / 'audio_meta.json', {'master_clock': 'audio_meta.json', 'duration': dur, 'rate': rate, 'voice': 'voice.wav', 'bgm': {'duck_db': -12}, 'words': timing, 'sfx': cues, 'mix': 'mix.wav'})
    m2, _ = fx.read_wav(mw)
    m2 = m2[:, 0]
    sx = []
    for c in cues:
        i0 = int(c['t'] * rate)
        seg_ = m2[i0 - int(0.05 * rate):i0 + int(0.05 * rate)]
        hp = np.diff(seg_)
        sx.append(round((np.argmax(np.abs(hp)) - int(0.05 * rate)) / rate * 1000, 1))
    bed_gap = float(np.sqrt(((bgm * duck)[int(0.1 * rate):int(0.25 * rate)] ** 2).mean()))
    bed_word = float(np.sqrt(((bgm * duck)[int((starts[2] + 0.15) * rate):int((starts[2] + 0.3) * rate)] ** 2).mean()))
    errs = [max(abs(w['start'] - s0), abs(w['end'] - (s0 + L))) for w, s0, L in zip(timing, starts, lens)]
    return ([check("five words timed from the narration's energy (within 30 ms)", len(timing) == 5 and max(errs) <= 0.03, [round(x * 1000) for x in errs], '<= 30 ms'), check('SFX land on their cue words (onset within 5 ms of the word start)', all((abs(x) <= 5 for x in sx)), sx, '<= 5 ms'), check('the bed is ducked ~12 dB under the voice', abs(20 * math.log10(bed_word / bed_gap) + 12) < 1.0, 20 * math.log10(bed_word / bed_gap), -12), check('one manifest holds words, cues and files; the mix length matches it', len(m2) == int(dur * rate) and json.loads(meta.read_text())['sfx'][1]['t'] == timing[4]['start'], len(m2) / rate, dur), check('negative control: the untreated voice track has no SFX transient at the cue', float(np.abs(np.diff(voice[int(cues[0]['t'] * rate):int(cues[0]['t'] * rate) + 200])).max()) < 0.05, float(np.abs(np.diff(voice[int(cues[0]['t'] * rate):int(cues[0]['t'] * rate) + 200])).max()), '< 0.05')], [mw, meta])

program.def:
def card(work):
    sr = 48000
    t = np.arange(3 * sr) / sr
    env = 0.5 + 0.5 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 3 * t)
    voice = env * (0.3 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 1000 * t) + 0.2 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 300 * t))
    rumble = 0.2 * np.sin(2 * np.pi * 35 * t)
    sig = voice + rumble
    y, ysr = _proc(work, 'voice', sig, sr, CHAIN39, out_sr=48000)
    rel_in = band_db(sig, sr, 35) - band_db(sig, sr, 1000)
    rel_out = band_db(y, ysr, 35) - band_db(y, ysr, 1000)

checks.name: bed ducks >= 8 dB under the voice (ratio 8)

def card(work):
    sr = 16000
    music = tone(220, 3, sr, 0.0376)
    voice = np.zeros(3 * sr)
    voice[sr:2 * sr] = tone(1000, 1, sr, 0.5)
    write_wav(work / 'music.wav', music, sr)
    write_wav(work / 'voice.wav', voice, sr)

    def duck(ratio):
        out = work / f'ducked_r{ratio}.wav'
        ffmpeg('-i', work / 'music.wav', '-i', work / 'voice.wav', '-filter_complex', f'[0:a][1:a]sidechaincompress=threshold=0.03:ratio={ratio}:attack=20:release=400[d]', '-map', '[d]', '-c:a', 'pcm_s16le', out)
        y, _, _ = read_wav(out)
        y = y[:, 0]
        return db(y[int(0.2 * sr):int(0.9 * sr)]) - db(y[int(1.4 * sr):int(1.9 * sr)])
    d8, d4 = (duck(8), duck(4))
    save(work, 'duck.json', {'duck_db_ratio8': d8, 'duck_db_ratio4': d4})
    return [truth('bed ducks >= 8 dB under the voice (ratio 8)', d8 >= 8, round(d8, 1)), truth('ratio 4 is gentler', 0 < d4 < d8, round(d4, 1)), eq('bed level before voice ≈ -31.5 dB', round(db(music), 1), -31.5, tol=0.3)]

title: Join chunks as PCM, not MP3 copy

checks.name: MP3 copy-join drifts by encoder padding (>= 1000 samples)

program.def:
def card(work):
    sr = 48000
    parts = []
    for i, f in enumerate((300, 400, 500)):
        p = write_wav(work / f'c{i}.wav', tone(f, 0.5, sr, 0.3), sr)
        parts.append(p)
        ffmpeg('-i', p, '-c:a', 'libmp3lame', '-b:a', '128k', work / f'c{i}.mp3')
    inputs = sum((['-i', str(p)] for p in parts), [])
    ffmpeg(*inputs, '-filter_complex', '[0:a][1:a][2:a]concat=n=3:v=0:a=1[a]', '-map', '[a]', work / 'joined_pcm.wav')
    (work / 'list.txt').write_text(''.join((f"file 'c{i}.mp3'\n" for i in range(3))))
    ffmpeg('-f', 'concat', '-safe', '0', '-i', work / 'list.txt', '-c', 'copy', work / 'joined_copy.mp3')
    ffmpeg('-i', work / 'joined_copy.mp3', work / 'joined_copy.wav')
    pcm = read_wav(work / 'joined_pcm.wav')[0].shape[0]
    mp3 = read_wav(work / 'joined_copy.wav')[0].shape[0]
    return [eq('PCM join is sample-exact', pcm, 3 * 24000), truth('MP3 copy-join drifts by encoder padding (>= 1000 samples)', abs(mp3 - 72000) >= 1000, mp3 - 72000)]
